IAKTT-S8.title: Branching algorithm: a purchase discount
IAKTT-S8.description:
A shop gives a discount depending on the purchase amount (rules chosen for a teaching example):

  • 1,000,000 soums or more — 10 %;
  • 500,000 soums or more — 5 %;
  • otherwise — no discount.

First draw the flowchart (the condition block is a diamond), then write the program. The discount is rounded down to whole soums.
IAKTT-S8.instructions: Input: n; n purchase amounts. Output: for each purchase, the discount and the amount to pay.

IAKTT-S15.title: Iterative algorithm: calculating deposit interest
IAKTT-S15.description:
An annual interest of r % is added to a deposit. With compound interest, each year the interest is calculated on the current balance and added to it; with simple interest, each year it is calculated only on the initial amount. Each year's interest is rounded down to whole soums.

This calculation model is a teaching example; real bank terms (the capitalization period, tax) are set in the contract.
IAKTT-S15.instructions: Input: amount rate years. Output: for each year a line “year balance” (compound interest); on the last line Oddiy: final_amount (simple interest; print the word Oddiy exactly as shown).
